text: dsh-pet-shura 是面向 DSH 网页界面的动态桌面宠物插件。它通过 webServer 注入页面脚本，并提供精灵图、会话事件驱动的语音气泡和线程状态接口。用户可以拖动宠物、调整大小、查看忙碌线程及其工具活动，并观察不同工作状态的动画。适合希望在网页中直观看到 DSH 工作进度的用户；无需额外账号或 API 密钥。

dsh-pet-shura adds an animated pet to DSH web. It injects a page script, serves a spritesheet, and shows session progress in speech updates and a thread status card. Users can drag and configure the pet and see activity animations. No account or API key is required.
想在 DSH 网页页面放一个会动的小宠物。
我想在网页上看到 DSH 当前正在处理什么。
能不能把各个忙碌会话和正在调用的工具显示出来？
希望宠物能根据任务开始、完成或报错切换状态。
怎么在网页里查看多个线程的工作进度？
Show me which DSH threads are busy and what tools they are using.
Add an animated companion to the DSH web interface.
I want a small visual indicator for session progress and errors.
dsh-pet-shura 的功能「会话进度气泡」：订阅 DSH session/event，将消息、工具调用、错误及完成等事件转成简短提示，并通过 /pet/events 的 SSE 流发送给页面宠物。
dsh-pet-shura 的功能「线程状态卡」：双击宠物后读取 /pet/status，显示正在工作的会话及其当前工具；状态由主进程跟踪的 session 活动生成。
dsh-pet-shura 的功能「可拖动与偏好设置」：用户可在页面拖动宠物并通过右键菜单调整尺寸、随机动作和视线追踪等偏好，位置与设置保存在浏览器本地。
dsh-pet-shura 的功能「动态精灵动画」：页面脚本使用精灵图绘制宠物，根据活动状态播放动画，并在鼠标附近切换朝向；精灵资源不可用时会移除宠物元素。

dsh-pet-shura README · 🐯 dsh-pet-shura — 修罗小脑斧：An animated desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web surface. A white
winged-armor guardian tiger with gold light armor, red wing armor, a green
spirit core and tiny fangs — hatching code-guarding, error-warning,
evidence-review and safety-gate instincts.

dsh-pet-shura README · 🐯 dsh-pet-shura — 修罗小脑斧：Built from a [hatch-pet](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
v2 spritesheet (1536×2288, 8 cols × 11 rows, 192×208 cells) with a
zero-dependency host plugin: it taps the served `index.html` and injects one
self-contained page script, plus serves the spritesheet over a dedicated
route. Nothing touches your model traffic.

dsh-pet-shura README · Features：| Feature | Detail |
|---|---|
| Speech bubble | Codex-style bubble above the pet, fed over SSE (`/pet/events`) |
| Thread overview | Tracks every busy thread (session): "🔧 3 个线程在忙：主线程在跑终端命令，子线程 #1 在写文件" — refreshed every 15 s, only when the picture changes |
| Line bank | Varied Chinese lines per event kind (user/work/done/error/ask/reply/turn-end/workflow/goal) plus idle self-talk every 45–90 s — the pet rarely repeats itself |
| Full animation | All 11 v2 rows: idle breathing, running left/right, waving, jumping, failed, waiting, task-running, review, plus 16-direction look loop |
| Look-at-mouse | Tracks your cursor with 16 direction frames (240px radius) |
| Drag & drop | Position remembered in `localStorage['dsh.pet.pos']` |
| Thread status card | Double-click the pet (or right-click → 线程状态) shows a token-styled card listing every busy thread (session) and what tool it is running, fed by `GET /pet/status` |
| Status symbols | Design-review extras: floating `?` while thinking, red shaking `!` on error, `✓` flash on success, `Zzz` rising while idle-waiting |
